podcast.title: "Smells Like Teen Spirit" Inspiration (1991)
podcast.body: One night in 1991, after going out drinking with Kurt Cobain, Kathleen Hannah commented that he smelled "sweet, almost like a particular type of deodorant marketed to teens." Cobain, who never wore deodorant, was inspired by her remark to use "Smells Like Teen Spirit" as the title for a new song. "When they returned to Kurt's place, she remarked that Kurt smelled sweet, almost like a particular type of deodorant marketed to teens."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Continued Artistic and Activist Work
xref.body: After Bikini Kill disbanded, Kathleen Hanna continued her work as an artist and feminist activist, engaging in music, art, photography, video, and other creative endeavors. "Kathleen Hannah continued her work as an artist and feminist activist with music, art, photography, video, and more."

xref.title: Kathleen Hannah's Fearlessness
xref.body: Singer Kathleen Hannah was renowned for her confrontational and fearless stage presence. It was common for her to physically engage with hecklers by diving off the stage, earning her a heroic status among both punk women and men. "When some dude moved up to heckle them, it wasn't uncommon for her to dive off the stage at the guy."

xref.title: Post-Beastie Boys Careers
xref.body: After the band's end, Mike D pursued interior design and record producing, married television, film, and music video director Tamara Davis, and had children. Adam Horowitz became a remixer under the name 41 Small Stars, played bass with cabaret singer Bridget Everett, expressed interest in more acting, and was married to Kathleen Hannah of the Riot Girl band Bikini Kill. "Adam Yauk was committed to his fight for the people of Tibet. He was a big supporter of feminist causes and LGBT rights."

xref.title: Spelling of "Riot Grrrl" Origin
xref.body: Kathleen Hanna and Tobi Vail published a zine in 1991 titled "Riot Girl" using the three 'R's spelling. The concept behind this specific spelling was to convey fierceness and reclaim the word "girl" by adding a "growl" sound. "But then we have another scene published in 1991 by Kathleen Hannah and Toby Vale. They called it Riot Girl with the three Rs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Teen Spirit Deodorant Connection
xref.body: Kathleen Hannah, a member of the all-girl punk band Bikini Kill, was the person who coined the phrase "Kurt smells like teen spirit," referring to the fruity-smelling deodorant brand. This deodorant was also the "deodorant of choice of Toby Vale," another member of Bikini Kill and Kurt Cobain's girlfriend. "Now, you may or may not know this, but teen spirit is a fruity smelling brand of deodorant that girls wear."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
